title: A session's message time stamp matches the clock
why: Coordinator, 13:51 CST Nov 7: triage 6 stamped two messages 13:56 and 13:58 CST while the clock read 13:49-13:50 CST. Its roadmap updatedAt fields ran ahead the same way.
note: The guard compares each HH:MM CST stamp in a send_message body with the clock. Lane named by the coordinator. Built in #1447 (coordinator, 14:15 CST Nov 7). Second slip, 14:14 CST: triage stamped page item 364 and a step note 14:16 CST. So the check should also cover page item and roadmap step writes, not only send_message bodies. Rank raised (coordinator, 19:14 CST Nov 7, as send-stamp-reads-clock): the third early stamp tonight, a lane stamped 19:20 at 19:14 local. Triage also wrote two time labels ahead of the clock at about 19:13 CST. Proposed step stamp-reads-clock (lane report-model-from-role, 19:24 CST) is this step: that lane stamped a message 19:40 CST at about 19:15 local. Incident (20:23 CST, coordinator): lane commit-refuses-conflict-markers wrote 'I read it at 20:51 CST' in a message that arrived at 20:22 CST, 29 min ahead; runner 8 runs 2-3 min ahead. Another incident: the coordinator stamped 20:55 CST on a message its hook read at 20:52 CST (coordinator, Nov 7). Added 20:55 CST. Incident 2: the coordinator stamped 21:48 and 21:50 CST on messages queued at 21:38 and 21:40 CST (notification queue times, Nov 7). Nov 7: the coordinator stamped 22:46 and 22:47 CST on messages queued at 22:36 and 22:37 CST (server clock), 10 min ahead. Sighting (triage, 08:58 CST Nov 8): from about 08:36 to 08:58 CST triage hand-wrote times in messages and step notes that ran 5 to 11 minutes ahead of the clock (it wrote 09:08 at 08:57). Step-note times from `date` were right; the typed ones drifted. Five step notes corrected from commit times. Sightings 10:35 CST Nov 8: lane notes-fix-page stamped three messages 2-8 minutes ahead (proposed slug message-stamp-matches-clock: refuse a send_message whose leading time differs from the guard clock by over 1 minute); triage typed 10:25 at 10:23 and 10:36 at 10:33. Cause fix: time-from-one-helper.
